Summary: Context collapse in AI refers to the narrowing of diverse perspectives in large language models, leading to homogenized outputs. This issue is being addressed through diversified training data and model architectures. Recent studies highlight the importance of maintaining epistemic diversity to prevent knowledge collapse.
